embassy-developments.instrument: Unlisted NCDs, 16,000 of ₹1 lakh face value
embassy-developments.name: Embassy Developments Ltd
embassy-developments.nextStep: Watch for the allotment disclosure, which should name the coupon and investor.
embassy-developments.summary: Board approved up to ₹160 crore of NCDs that won't be listed, as an enabling authorisation. In July 2026 the company raised its overall NCD borrowing limit to ₹1,570 crore, so more private placements are likely.

my-home-group.name: My Home Group (Hyderabad)
my-home-group.nextStep: Search MCA charges for My Home Constructions and group companies for debenture-trustee charge holders, and check ICRA, CARE and CRISIL for rated instruments.
my-home-group.summary: Large private Hyderabad developer (My Home Constructions and group companies). This scan found no public NCD issue, exchange filing or rated debenture. If the group borrows through NCDs, they are likely private placements with funds, which show up first as MCA charges in favour of a debenture trustee.

purshottam-investofin.caution: Unrated, unsecured, and the issuer is reported to be under scrutiny. Treat as a special-situations lead only.
purshottam-investofin.name: Purshottam Investofin Ltd
purshottam-investofin.nextStep: Find what the scrutiny is (exchange queries, SEBI or RBI action) before spending more time.
purshottam-investofin.summary: NBFC raising short-term money at 13% with an investor put after six months and a 2% penalty rate on default. Reports tie the raise to the company's recent financial difficulties and scrutiny.

qgo-finance.caution: Mostly unsecured and long-dated; check capital adequacy and asset quality before looking further.
qgo-finance.instrument: Private placement NCDs: ₹2 crore secured, ₹19.75 crore unsecured
qgo-finance.name: QGO Finance Ltd
qgo-finance.nextStep: Read the latest annual report for NPAs, capital adequacy and borrowing mix.
qgo-finance.security: Mostly unsecured; secured part has a pari passu charge on receivables
qgo-finance.summary: Small NBFC raising long-dated money at 12% to fund lending. About 90% of the issue is unsecured.

rajapushpa-properties.caution: The NCD coupon and ISIN come from earlier notes and are not confirmed by a primary source.
rajapushpa-properties.instrument: Unlisted secured NCD, ISIN INE0L1W07030 per earlier desk notes
rajapushpa-properties.name: Rajapushpa Properties Pvt Ltd
rajapushpa-properties.nextStep: Confirm the ISIN on NSDL India BondInfo, find the debenture trustee charge on MCA, and check whether any agency rates the NCD itself.
rajapushpa-properties.rating: ICRA A- (Negative) on bank loans, Sep 2025
rajapushpa-properties.summary: Hyderabad residential developer. ICRA reaffirmed A- in September 2025 but cut the outlook to Negative: debt rose 42.4% in FY2025 while operating cash flow fell sharply, and cash-flow adequacy dropped to 24%. ICRA's rating covers ₹1,400 crore of bank loans, not the NCD. Group company Rajapushpa Infra is rated ICRA BBB+ (Stable).

suraj-estate-developers.coupon: Effective rate rising to 17% a year, paid monthly
suraj-estate-developers.investor: India Real Estate Investment Fund Series 2 (ICICI Venture); trustee IDBI Trusteeship
suraj-estate-developers.name: Suraj Estate Developers Ltd
suraj-estate-developers.nextStep: Pull the company's exchange disclosure for the exact coupon step-ups and security, then track interest cover in quarterly results.
suraj-estate-developers.summary: Mumbai developer funding projects through an AIF rather than the public debt market. A 17% effective rate from a large AIF shows what private credit charges this kind of borrower.
